metadata.title: आदिवासी औरत अस्पताल से छुट्टी के बाद 15 किलोमीटर पैदल चढ़ी पहाड़ ।PVTG। Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description:
The Main Bhi Bharat team is currently touring Chhattisgarh, meeting the Adivasi communities there. During one of our shoots, while walking through the jungle, we met a man who was on his way to the next village to pick up his wife from the hospital. His wife was admitted to the hospital for treatment for Anaemia.

We also met the whole family (man, wife, two small children) as they trekked back through the jungle and mountainous terrain, to their home about 20 kms away. Listen in as we tried to unravel the daily travails of their lives.

For updates regarding upcoming videos and stories follows our social media accounts linked below::
